transcript: Speaker. This is InPublic. Speaking normally. Deepgram is listening to what I'm saying, and from that speech, InPublic starts deciding what actually deserves being shown visually. Then it sends ideas into Excalidraw. Text boxes, relationships, arrows, structures, while I'm still talking, the interesting part isn't the transcript. I don't want just subtitles on the speech. I want the canvas to actually express what I mean. So if I explain an idea, the structure of the idea starts the structure of the idea should start appearing besides me and Rita. There's still a lot I want to include, especially how expressive the videos can be. Because this is where InPublic is right now.
